items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The loop over plate.rows()[0] (A1-A12) aspirates and dispenses 100 uL from reservoir A1 with p300; end_state:plate passed.
Each iteration does pick_up_tip, aspirate, dispense, drop_tip; tip_before_aspirate and tip_dropped_at_end passed.
100 uL is within p300 limits, apiLevel 2.15 is in the allowed range, and the simulator ran with no errors.
The protocol does only the one required transfer; comments and metadata match the code.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and pipettes and transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1-A12 with the p300, using a fresh tip for each well. All measured checks passed and I found no issues.
